name: mission-control
description: OpenClaw Mission Control — open-source agent orchestration dashboard

scripts.test:e2e:ui-visual: pnpm build && node scripts/clean-visual-output.mjs --mode playwright && MC_VISUAL_SNAPSHOTS=1 MC_VISUAL_OUTPUT_DIR=test-results/visual-current playwright test tests/product-line-switcher-ui.spec.ts tests/feature-flags-admin-ui.spec.ts tests/e2e/ready-for-owner-kanban.spec.ts tests/e2e/spec-007-ui-visual.spec.ts tests/workspace-switcher-flag-off.spec.ts tests/product-line-scope-api.spec.ts tests/product-line-scope-matrix.spec.ts tests/product-line-events.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:visual-manifest: pnpm run verify:node && node scripts/verify-visual-manifest.mjs --mode playwright
scripts.test:e2e:openclaw:local: pnpm run verify:node && E2E_GATEWAY_EXPECTED=0 playwright test -c playwright.openclaw.local.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:openclaw:gateway: pnpm run verify:node && E2E_GATEWAY_EXPECTED=1 playwright test -c playwright.openclaw.gateway.config.ts
scripts.storybook: pnpm run verify:node && STORYBOOK_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 storybook dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 6006
scripts.build-storybook: pnpm run verify:node && STORYBOOK_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 storybook build
scripts.test:visual:storybook: pnpm run verify:node && node scripts/clean-visual-output.mjs --mode storybook && STORYBOOK_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 MC_VISUAL_OUTPUT_DIR=test-results/visual-current vitest run --config vitest.storybook.config.ts && node scripts/write-storybook-visual-manifests.mjs
scripts.test:visual:manifest: pnpm run verify:node && node scripts/verify-visual-manifest.mjs --mode storybook
scripts.visual:reg-suit:playwright: pnpm run verify:node && reg-suit -c regconfig.playwright.json run
scripts.visual:reg-suit:storybook: pnpm run verify:node && reg-suit -c regconfig.storybook.json run
scripts.test:evidence:screenshots: pnpm run verify:node && node scripts/check-guardrails.mjs --suite spec-evidence-screenshots
scripts.task-pipeline:guardrails: pnpm run verify:node && node scripts/check-guardrails.mjs --suite task-pipeline
scripts.test:all: pnpm check:strict-scope && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.quality:gate: pnpm guardrails && pnpm test:all && pnpm audit:high
scripts.postinstall: node -e "try{require('better-sqlite3')}catch(e){if(e.code==='ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED'||/NODE_MODULE_VERSION/.test(e.message)){console.error('\n⚠  better-sqlite3 compiled for wrong Node version. Run: pnpm rebuild better-sqlite3\n');process.exit(1)}}"

author: Builderz Labs
